claims.text: The experiments were conducted on 10 different datasets, including 9 Amazon product review datasets and the Yelp challenge dataset.
The datasets include reviews from various domains, specifically focusing on restaurant reviews in the Yelp dataset.
The datasets were preprocessed to ensure they are in a $t$-core fashion, including only users and items with at least $t$ reviews.
